description: Wired internet coverage of settlements (Kyrgyztelecom) is a series of data sets listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kyrgyztelecom. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its title on the portal is "Зымдуу интернет менен камтуу" (Russian). The portal files it under the publisher Kyrgyztelecom. Its tags are телекоммуникация. It offers 1 resource(s) in DOCX. The portal shows 2024-02-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
